description: Paid ($0.01 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): call this before your agent pays an address, or before accepting money from one. Send any chain's wallet address (EVM 0x..., Solana, Tron, Bitcoin, XRP Ledger, Algorand, or another currency OFAC lists). Get back green/orange/red: red SANCTIONED_ADDRESS with the SDN entry (name, programs, currency) when the address is on the OFAC SDN list, red or orange when GoPlus reports theft, phishing, laundering or mixer use (EVM). Never pay or accept funds on red. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.
